notes.title: Update - Minor Glitches Fixed
notes.notes: Some bug fixes and glitches were addressed.  Primarily relating to the tracking of leaderboards and uploading scores to leaderboards.

notes.title: BLACK FRIDAY UPDATE
notes.notes: With more than 99.9% of the votes now reporting in the 2024 Presidential Election,  American Election Simulator   now has been updated with new voter registration data,  voter preference data,  and turnout data that better reflects the most recent election cycle.

notes.title: Version Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Version 1.01 of American Election Simulator is now available.


- Leaderboards now accessible from main menu.
- Leaderboard pages now refresh quicker.
- Some swing states have been adjusted to better reflect voter registration data.
- Turnout settings have been slightly adjusted on a national level.
